question.text: A whistle of frequency $1000 \mathrm{~Hz}$ is sounded on a car travelling towards a cliff with velocity of 18 $\mathrm{~m} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ normal to the cliff. If $\mathrm{c}=330 \mathrm{~m} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$, then the apparent frequency of the echo as heard by the car driver is nearly

solution.text: By the concept of accoustic, the observer and source are moving towards each other, each with a velocity of $18 \mathrm{~m} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ $\therefore \mathrm{v}^{\prime}=\frac{330+18}{330-18} \times 1000 \approx 1115 \mathrm{~Hz}$
